notes.title: The Fighters available now
notes.content:
90s style Indie fighting game
[b]you can play the game with Xbox Controller or Keyboard[/b]

[b]The game contains 3 game methods[/b]
[h2]1- Chapters contain[/h2]
         [h2]3D[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706786/a8ad9d0d85d31a1cb22f6fe91c134817647577d8.jpg[/img]
[u] in 3D Chapters, you will be able to switch the camera to First Person Cam and play[/u]
[h2]2- Local multiplayer ( 3D)[/h2]

[h2]3- Online ( 3D )[/h2]
In the Online mode, you are going to face a real person and fight them to get more and more ranks to open your mission and get EXP to build your own character and make him stronger, 
[b]there are 5 Ranks in the game for each rank you are going to get EXP to build your ability,[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42706786/d28dd9e6b27f6354d5ef5ecfef70092aae43c0d9.jpg[/img]
[u]for each win, you are going to get 2 points
if you lost the game, you are going to lose 2 points[/u]
if you faced any problems, please send an email to (skullsameh.work@gmail.com)
Waiting for your feedback and review :D
I hope you enjoy the game,
